name: New Fresh Urban Farmers (NFUF) Paid Internship
what_you_do: Work on urban farms and school market gardens, help at food banks, learn cooking and business planning, and lead volunteers. Present a business plan at a public event.
who_can_apply: High school students in Dougherty County, GA.
pay_detail: The old NFUF page (read Oct 11, 2026) said $10 per hour, about 8 to 12 hours per week during the school year. The new site gives no rate.
duration: September to May: two Saturdays plus after-school hours
deadline_text: The NFUF page was removed when the site was redesigned in October 2026. The new site says FreshShare creates paid training for youth but gives no NFUF application or dates. Email info@flintriverfresh.org to ask if it is still hiring.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Apply Here form on the NFUF page.
notes: A USDA city farming grant pays for it. Office: 125 Pine Avenue, Suite 150, Albany, GA. Phone: 229-352-6591. Email: info@flintriverfresh.org.
